## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any related issue. Include a before/after example when useful.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. For gameplay changes, include client/server context, optional integrations, and save/reload checks. State anything you could not test.

## Compatibility

Describe any effect on existing worlds, item or recipe IDs, configuration, automation, or optional integrations. Write "None" if there is no effect.

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Documentation and feature status match the change, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and files contain no credentials or private information.
